A '''public relations droid''' or '''PR droid''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] model. The company [[Renew]] employed the public relations droid [[MT-7T]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korad]] prior to its bankruptcy.

==Appearances==
*[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] {{1st}} {{C|Tokyo only}}
